complexity.notes: A two-pointer approach over the original string would reduce space to O(1) by avoiding the filtered copy and reversed slice. Note str.isalnum() is Unicode-aware, but the problem restricts s to printable ASCII, where it matches exactly [A-Za-z0-9].
complexity.summary: Builds a filtered, lowercased string of only alphanumeric characters, then checks whether it equals its reverse. One linear pass to filter plus a linear comparison.
